BiblicalUsage: Azzan was the father of Paltiel, the prince of Issachar chosen to divide the land among the tribes. He appears once, named only as a father, and his son's work of dividing the inheritance is his memorial.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the men who divided the land are remembered because the inheritance was real, and every tribe's portion was measured by God's command.
